title.en: Chapter 24 — Too Late by One Day

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: ركبنا أول قطار الصبح، بس كنا متأخرين.
sentences.en: We took the first train in the morning, but we were late.

sentences.ar: الزبون كان ميت ومرته مجروحة جروح صعبة.
sentences.en: The client was dead and his wife badly wounded.

sentences.ar: الشرطة حسبت إنها هي اللي عملتها.
sentences.en: The police assumed she had done it.

sentences.ar: هولمز قال: في تلات رصاصات، مش تنتين.
sentences.en: Holmes said: there are three shots, not two.

sentences.ar: كتب رسالة بنفس رسم الرجال وبعتها لبيت قريب.
sentences.en: He wrote a message in the same dancing figures and sent it to a nearby house.

sentences.ar: اللي إجا كان الرجل اللي كان يلاحقها من أمريكا.
sentences.en: The man who came was the one who had been pursuing her from America.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: استعملت لغته، فما شك إنها مش منها.
sentences.en: Holmes said: I used his own language, so he did not doubt it.
